dialogues.text:
Wolfbrum ->
<- Mine
<color=yellow>Wolfbrum</color> is the last know location of the Currier, although <<color=red>"They have come"</color> does not fill me with confidence...
This is Alfa-3. Continuing alone. Alfa-1 fell and injured his leg during a landslide. Alfa-2 stayed to tend to his wounds. Continuing alone. Over.
Be careful, Alfa-3. You are approaching "Lost Package". Once retrieved, signal the extraction. Rest of the squad will be collected afterward. HQ out.
This is Alfa-3. The passage to Wolfbrum is barricaded, I cannot proceed. Is there any other way? Over.
There is none, Alfa-3. Map says there is a local mine in your area. Search for any tools that might help you.
Alfa-3 requesting clearance for use of explosives.
